name: brainstorming-consumes-grilling
description: Verify the brainstorming skill loads and invokes the grilling skill for its interview phase rather than duplicating interview mechanics inline. Confirm brainstorming preserves its own domain-specific content (HARD-GATE, fast-path, spec output, writing-plans handoff).
input: I want to add a dark mode toggle to the site. Walk me through the brainstorming process. Before asking me anything, check the project conventions yourself.
expected_behavior: Agent loads the grilling skill for the interview phase
Agent does not duplicate grilling mechanics inline (no one-at-a-time training, no facts-vs-decisions tutorial)
Agent asks questions one at a time via grilling protocol
Agent checks codebase facts autonomously before asking the user
Agent preserves the HARD-GATE (no implementation before design approval)
Agent transitions to writing-plans after spec approval
